       s.creation_year AS creation_year,
       m.name AS museum_name

LIMIT 1"
  ,

The RETURN clause selects the sculpture's name (the requested attribute) and includes creation_year and museum_name for observability and debugging, while ordering by creation_year descending to get the most recent and limiting to one result. It strictly uses the schema's relationship types and node properties without introducing any invalid elements."
  }
